en.headline: Insurance Authority fines FWD Life HK$19.5 million over AML controls
en.dek: The regulator found deficiencies in identifying third-party payers, handling potentially suspicious transactions, screening politically exposed persons and conducting customer due diligence.
body: The Insurance Authority has required FWD Life Insurance Company (Bermuda) Limited to pay a fine of HK$19.5 million after an on-site inspection under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance.

The Authority found shortcomings in the company’s controls for identifying payers of third-party payments, handling potentially suspicious transactions including those involving cash, collecting and screening information on politically exposed persons, and conducting customer due diligence on certain transactions.

The company has implemented a series of measures to address the issues and strengthen its governance, controls and monitoring. The Authority recognised that the company accepted the findings early and has worked to rectify the problems.

FWD said it takes regulatory compliance seriously and that remedial measures, including a full review of new policyholders during the relevant period, have largely been completed. It confirmed no ineligible customers had successfully taken out policies.

zh.headline: 保監局罰富衛人壽1950萬元 涉打擊洗錢管控不足
zh.dek: 保監局實地查察後發現公司在識別第三方付款人、處理可疑交易、篩查政治人物及客戶盡職審查方面存在不足。
body: 保險業監管局根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集條例》進行實地查察後，要求富衛人壽保險（百慕達）有限公司繳付1950萬元罰款。
保監局發現，該公司在識別第三方付款的付款人的管控、處理包括涉及現金在內的潛在可疑交易的管控、收集和篩查政治人物資料，以及就個別交易進行客戶盡職審查方面，存在不足之處。
公司已落實一系列措施解決所發現的問題，並加強管治、管控和監察。保監局認同公司及早接受調查結果，並致力糾正問題及改善管治和管控。
富衛回應表示，已知悉相關反洗錢例行檢查結果，非常重視監管合規，針對已識別待改進事項的補救措施已大致完成，包括全面覆核相關期間內的新投保客戶，確認並沒有讓不合資格的客戶成功投保。
